name: 02891 · Westerly, RI
findings: ZIP 02891 (Westerly) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02891 (Westerly) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02891 (Westerly) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).
